about_the_game:
Reach for the Stars

A turn-based card action RPG set in a picture book–like world.
Combine strategy and timing-based action commands to create your own unique adventure!

Strategy Meets Action

  • Build your deck by combining your hand with your companions’ skill cards

  • During attacks and defenses, perform timing-based mini-games!
    Succeed, and your effects will power up

  • Equip mysterious ancient relics called OOPArts to gain special abilities

    • Example: Choose a card you want guaranteed in your opening hand

    • Example: Reduce a card’s cost to 0

Companions and Growth

  • A book-smart treasure hunter, a guy cursed with static electricity, a support specialist, a reckless gambler… each companion has their own quirks

  • Deepen your bonds to unlock unique cards and powerful skills

  • Defeat enemies to collect new cards, and level up to earn skill points

  • Combine abilities to overcome puzzle-like ruins and uncover hidden treasures!

World & Story

The stage is Estella, a land of ancient ruins and starlit legends.

You awaken in a crater-like place, only to meet Spica, a cheerful treasure hunter.
Though she suspects you’re bad luck (and secretly hopes you’ll lead her to riches), she decides to travel with you.
What begins as a small journey soon grows into a tale of lost civilizations, star-born mysteries, and choices that will shape your destiny.

Will you strengthen your bonds with your allies… or face an unexpected ending?

Art Style

  • A storybook aesthetic: 3D environments with 2D characters

  • A lighthearted, cute atmosphere wrapped around an epic journey through stars and ruins

Playtime

  • Main story: around 12 hours

  • With side quests and relic collection: 20+ hours of adventure

Perfect For Players Who…

  • Love RPGs with strong stories and charming worlds

  • Enjoy card-based combat with a light learning curve

  • Prefer a heartwarming, picture book–like adventure over hardcore difficulty

✨ Step onto the stage of a story written among the stars!
